postMessageLimitations: Only script-enabled frames reached by the browser-context init observer can report traffic.
window.postMessage calls are observed through a transparent Proxy; later page replacement of the method can bypass outbound capture.
Cross-origin WindowProxy access can bypass a realm wrapper or attribute a sent call to the target realm, so delivered receive records are authoritative cross-origin evidence.
MessagePort, BroadcastChannel, service-worker, and browser-internal messaging are outside this collector.
Transferable or non-cloneable payloads can be reduced to type summaries without changing their original transfer lists.
